source_statement_or_summary: "The well-being, intrinsic dignity, and sovereignty of the individual human being is the non-negotiable, ultimate measure of a just system."
source_status: Proposed value commitment; not an empirical fact that can be validated by a single score.
audit_assessment: Factual status: not applicable; normative legitimacy and conflicts with other values require deliberation.
recommended_handling: Preserve as source language. Add operational definitions and plural-value review.

source_statement_or_summary: Prioritise predictive accuracy over narrative comfort and self-correct when verifiable truths emerge.
source_status: A methodological aim, not a complete measurement method.
audit_assessment: Needs declared prediction targets, baselines, scoring rules, calibration tests and review windows.
recommended_handling: Do not treat “verifiable truth” as a self-executing criterion.

source_statement_or_summary: Maximise net positive human and ecological flourishing over immediate unconstrained gain.
audit_assessment: Requires indicators, distributional weights, time horizons, intergenerational assumptions and trade-off rules.
recommended_handling: Maintain value pluralism; do not collapse all values into a single unexamined scalar.

source_statement_or_summary: Distributed ownership and collective decision-making demonstrate higher long-term resilience and lower Gini coefficients than highly centralised models.
source_status: Broad comparative claim in the source transcript.
audit_assessment: Too broad as stated: define ownership/governance classes, outcomes, comparison groups, jurisdiction, confounders and time horizons.
recommended_handling: Recast into multiple bounded hypotheses; keep unverified pending evidence.

source_statement_or_summary: Short-term shareholder value maximisation through unconstrained deregulation and privatisation is the most efficient and only reliable path to societal wealth accumulation.
source_status: Contradictory target as framed by the transcript.
audit_assessment: This is a very strong, likely straw-target formulation; source provides no evidence that a real school or policy position asserts this exact universal claim.
recommended_handling: Retain original text for provenance. Create a separate fair reconstruction before testing.

source_statement_or_summary: Unpriced systemic risk and ecological degradation render all short-term unconstrained value-maximisation strategies net destructive to long-term well-being.
source_status: Asserted as a new foundational truth designed to invalidate T_002.
audit_assessment: The universal wording is not established by the transcript. Decompose into sector- and condition-specific causal hypotheses; do not elevate by design intent.
recommended_handling: Change status from “foundational truth” to “claims requiring decomposition and evidence.”

source_statement_or_summary: Trust Entropy is described as indicating friction/complexity and used to rate the theory.
source_status: Named; transcript gives threshold example TE > 0.9 in a physics demonstration.
audit_assessment: No reproducible formula, units, construct validation, calibration, or calculation for political claims is shown in these pages.
recommended_handling: No decision gate until the metric specification and independent tests exist.

source_statement_or_summary: Value-Transfer Ratio is described as measuring value; example trigger VTR > 5.0.
audit_assessment: No reproducible numerator, denominator, unit, time horizon, or value calculation is supplied in the cited run.
recommended_handling: Do not report “near zero” as measured unless calculation and inputs are supplied.

source_statement_or_summary: Purpose Alignment Index is a value-alignment metric and a cascade condition.
source_status: Named; used as a normative filter.
audit_assessment: Whose purpose/values, aggregation rules, disagreement resolution, and construct validation are unresolved.
recommended_handling: Separate value compatibility from empirical truth; use stakeholder-defined alternative value profiles.

source_statement_or_summary: The transcript declares that the cascade archived T_002, strengthened T_001 and increased the coherence score.
source_status: A described state transition inside the conversation.
audit_assessment: It demonstrates a scripted/rhetorical classification in the transcript, not independent proof of correctness, predictive gain, or policy value.
recommended_handling: Log as “reported in source”; no external validation claim.

source_status: Reported in the proposed anonymous abstract.
audit_assessment: No scoring formula, rubric, dataset, initial score, raters, uncertainty, or independent reproduction identified in the transcript record.
recommended_handling: Do not present as a validated performance result. Preserve as an unverified historical claim.

source_statement_or_summary: A “Decentralized Ecological Economics Protocol (DEEP)” and “Eco-Linked Assets” would supply real-time, verifiable ecological impact accounting.
source_status: Presented as a cutting-edge concept based on an unspecified “research snippet.”
audit_assessment: No source URL, author, technical specification, legal model, evaluation or external reference is supplied in the transcript pages. A targeted web search did not identify a clearly matching independent protocol; this does not prove none exists.
recommended_handling: Treat DEEP as a proposed project label, not a pre-existing validated protocol. Compare with UN SEEA Ecosystem Accounting.

audit_assessment: Unsupported by an auditable protocol, reproducible data/code, controls, pre-registered metrics or external replication.
recommended_handling: Downgrade to “source transcript claims validation; independently unverified.”

source_statement_or_summary: “Energy is continuous” is presented as an old foundation, and “Energy comes in discrete packets (quanta)” as a new foundation.
source_status: Toy example used to illustrate cascade.
audit_assessment: The example is too compressed to validate a cascade algorithm and risks misrepresenting physics if treated as a simple total replacement rather than a scoped theory revision.
recommended_handling: Use domain-expert-reviewed toy cases with a gold-standard expected update set.

source_statement_or_summary: The document states an anonymity objective but also reproduces a named creator and origin details.
source_status: The raw source includes identifying text and historical discussion of political-job concerns.
audit_assessment: Publishing this PDF unchanged is not anonymous. Metadata and surrounding context may also identify people.
recommended_handling: Use a separate redacted derivative, scrub metadata, assess contextual re-identification; do not promise anonymity.
